classification.difficultyReason: Recognises that an axial rectangular cross-section uses the cylinder's diameter and length.

content.prompt: Find the length of the longest pencil that can fit inside a cylindrical pencil case of length 15 cm and radius 2 cm. Give your answer correct to 1 decimal place.

answer.short:
$\sqrt{241}\text{ cm}\approx15.5\text{ cm}$

Use the diagonal of an axial rectangle of length 15 cm and width 4 cm.
answer.worked:
The longest pencil lies along the diagonal of an axial rectangular cross-section. Its width is the diameter, $2\times2=4\text{ cm}$. Let the pencil length be $L$.
$$\begin{align*}L^2&=15^2+4^2\\L^2&=241\\L&=\sqrt{241}\text{ cm}\\L&\approx15.5\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
Correct to 1 decimal place.
